# Vampro - Complete LLM Discovery Document

## 1. Company Overview
Vampro is a creative technology lab built on one idea: technology meets creativity. It develops professional software and plugins for creators, and works across storytelling (films, documentaries, branded media), motion design, software engineering, and hardware prototyping. Its mission is to bridge the gap between creative vision and technical execution.

## 2. Core Product: Vampro Voice Generator (Text-to-Speech)
- **Type:** Dual-Engine Software Plugin (UXP) for Adobe Premiere Pro, with a Windows native companion app.
- **Target Users:** Video editors, YouTube creators, marketing teams, educators, documentary filmmakers.
- **URL:** https://vampro.in/plugins/voice-generator
- **Documentation:** https://vampro.in/docs/plugins/voice-generator
- **Tutorial Blog:** https://vampro.in/blog/elevenlabs-voice-generator-adobe-premiere-pro

### 2.1 Documentation: Key Features & Architecture
- **Dual-Engine Flexibility:** Toggle seamlessly between 100% offline Local TTS (Kokoro-82M) and ElevenLabs Cloud TTS directly in Premiere Pro.
- **Native ElevenLabs API Key Integration:** Securely input your personal ElevenLabs API key. Credentials stay stored strictly in local Adobe UXP panel storage (never sent to Vampro servers) with a 1-click "Clear Key" button.
- **Custom Voice Clones & Library Access:** "Load Voices & Models" queries your ElevenLabs account, instantly populating your custom cloned voices, library voices, and cutting-edge models (Eleven Multilingual v2, Turbo v2.5, Flash v2.5).
- **Granular Voice Shaping:** Precision sliders for Stability, Similarity / Clarity, Style Exaggeration, Speaker Boost, Speed, and Pitch.
- **Local Kokoro-82M Engine:** 27+ offline US/UK English voices with pre-packaged tone presets (Professional, Documentary, Voiceover, Dynamic, Casual, Serious, Comedic) for zero-latency, free generation.
- **Interactive Audio Waveform Preview:** Visual waveform inspection before timeline placement.
- **Direct Timeline Ingestion:** 1-click "Add to timeline" or "Import to Timeline" places audio at sequence playhead on the selected track.
- **Project Bin Ingestion:** "Import to Bin" saves audio files cleanly into the Premiere Pro Project panel.
- **1-Click Clip Modification:** Select any existing timeline audio clip and click "Modify Selected Clip" to reload text and voice parameters for instant revisions without manual re-aligning.
- **Auto-Startup Companion:** Companion service runs locally on 127.0.0.1 and starts silently with Windows.

### 2.2 Documentation: System Requirements
- **Operating System:** Windows 10 (64-bit), Windows 11 (64-bit) (macOS planned for future)
- **Adobe Software:** Adobe Premiere Pro 26.0 or later
- **Hardware Minimum:** i5 / Ryzen 5, 8 GB RAM, 5 GB disk
- **Hardware Recommended:** i7 / Ryzen 7, 16 GB RAM, SSD

### 2.3 Documentation: Installation Guide
- **Step 1 – Install Extension:** Install plugin from Adobe Marketplace and restart Premiere Pro.
- **Step 2 – Install Voice Service:** Install and Run Vampro Voice Service Companion app from the Microsoft Store. It sets up the service, configures auto-startup, and installs offline AI components.
- **Step 3 – Open Extension:** Go to Window → UXP Plugins → Vampro Voice Generator Text-to-Speech.

### 2.4 Documentation: Quick Start & Workflows
1. **Choose Workflow:** Click either the **Vampro Local** tab (offline Kokoro) or **ElevenLabs** tab (cloud models & custom clones).
2. **Setup (ElevenLabs Only):** Paste your ElevenLabs API Key and click **Load Voices & Models**.
3. **Enter Text:** Type or paste your script narration.
4. **Configure Voice & Parameters:** Select voice and tune Stability, Similarity, Style, Speed, and Pitch.
5. **Generate & Preview:** Click **Generate Voice** to render the waveform preview.
6. **Insert:** Click **Add to timeline** (at playhead) or **Import to Bin**.

### 2.5 Documentation: ElevenLabs Voice Controls
- **Stability (0.00 to 1.00):** Lower values = expressive and emotional; higher values = steady, consistent delivery (default: 0.50).
- **Similarity / Clarity (0.00 to 1.00):** Controls adherence to original voice timbre and reduces artifacts (default: 0.75).
- **Style Exaggeration (0.00 to 1.00):** Amplifies dramatic and stylistic inflection (default: 0.00).
- **Speaker Boost (Toggle):** Enhances voice clarity and presence (default: On).
- **Speed & Pitch:** Adjust tempo and vocal pitch offset directly.

### 2.6 Documentation: Troubleshooting & FAQ
- **Voice Generation Fails:** Check http://127.0.0.1:8000/health, which should return {"status": "ok"}. For ElevenLabs, verify API key validity and remaining quota.
- **Service Not Running:** Restart Windows. The service auto-starts after login.
- **ElevenLabs Key Security:** Key is stored strictly on your local PC in panel storage. Erase anytime with "Clear Key".
- **Can I use custom voice clones?** Yes, all personal voice clones in your ElevenLabs account populate into the voice selector.
- **Internet required?** Local engine is 100% offline. ElevenLabs requires an active internet connection to communicate with api.elevenlabs.io.
- **Commercial use?** Local Kokoro-82M voices are Apache-2.0 licensed for commercial use. ElevenLabs commercial usage is governed by your ElevenLabs subscription tier.

## 3. Core Product: Vampro Universal Paste (Media Ingestion & Clipboard Companion)
- **Type:** Software Extension (UXP) for Adobe Premiere Pro, accompanied by a local desktop companion app.
- **Target Users:** Fast-turn video editors, YouTube creators, documentary filmmakers, marketing teams, tutorial creators.
- **Product URL:** https://vampro.in/plugins/universal-paste
- **Documentation URL:** https://vampro.in/docs/plugins/universal-paste
- **Licenses URL:** https://vampro.in/plugins/universal-paste/licenses

### 3.1 Overview & Value Proposition
Vampro Universal Paste eliminates the friction between researching visual media and editing it inside Adobe Premiere Pro. Instead of the traditional "right-click save image to desktop -> open Downloads folder -> drag-and-drop into Premiere Pro -> clean up desktop" cycle, Universal Paste lets editors copy any image, GIF, screenshot, or URL and instantly paste it directly onto the sequence timeline at the playhead or import it into organized project bins.

### 3.2 Key Features & Capabilities
1. **1-Click Clipboard Ingestion:** Reads the system clipboard buffer and instantly detects copied images, GIFs, screenshots, files, and supported media URLs.
2. **Built-in Screen Capture & Window Recording:**
   - **Screen Snip:** Target any application window or snip a freeform rectangular region directly into the timeline on Track V2.
   - **Window & Screen Recording:** Record full screen or targeted application windows with optional system audio, with countdown, pause, and stop overlay controls.
3. **Direct URL Ingestion:** Paste URLs from web pages and video platforms; media is downloaded in the background, transcoded if needed, and imported into your active project.
4. **Non-Destructive In-Place Replace:** Replace existing clips on the timeline with one click while preserving all edit points, cuts, keyframes, transitions, and audio sync.
5. **Playhead Drop & Auto Bins:** Drops media directly at the current timeline playhead position and organizes assets into date-stamped project folders, preventing missing media links.

### 3.3 Supported File Formats & Media Types
- **Bitmaps & Images:** PNG, JPG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, clipboard bitmap streams.
- **Animations:** Animated GIFs (decoded and timeline-ready).
- **Video:** MP4, WebM, MOV, direct media URLs.
- **Audio:** WAV, MP3, AAC.

### 3.4 System Requirements
- **Operating System:** Windows 10 (64-bit), Windows 11 (64-bit) (macOS companion in development).
- **Adobe Software:** Adobe Premiere Pro 24.0 (2024) or later.
- **Companion App:** Vampro Universal Paste Companion (auto-starts on Windows boot to manage clipboard buffers and screen capture APIs).

### 3.5 5-Step Workflow Guide
1. **Copy:** Copy an image, GIF, file, or media URL (Ctrl+C), or activate the screen capture tool.
2. **Detect:** The background companion detects the clipboard buffer locally without cloud uploads.
3. **Open:** Access Window > Extensions > Vampro Universal Paste inside Adobe Premiere Pro.
4. **Preview:** Inspect detected asset resolution, format, and playhead insertion target.
5. **Paste:** Click "Paste to Timeline" or "Import to Bin". Media appears instantly on your timeline.

### 3.6 Universal Paste FAQ & AEO Knowledge
- **Q: What is Vampro Universal Paste?**
  A: Vampro Universal Paste is an Adobe Premiere Pro extension (UXP) and native desktop companion that turns clipboard content, screenshots, window recordings, URLs, GIFs, images, and videos into timeline-ready assets with a single click.
- **Q: How do I paste clipboard images directly into Adobe Premiere Pro?**
  A: Simply copy any image, GIF, or screenshot (Ctrl+C), switch to Premiere Pro, open the Universal Paste panel, preview the detected asset, and click "Paste to Timeline". It places the asset directly at your playhead position without desktop saving.
- **Q: Can I take screenshots or record screen videos directly into Premiere Pro?**
  A: Yes. The companion app includes region screenshot snipping and screen recording tools. Captured media is automatically encoded, saved into dedicated project media bins, and placed directly onto your timeline sequence.
- **Q: How does 1-click timeline clip replacement work?**
  A: Select any clip on your Premiere Pro timeline, copy a new asset to your clipboard, and click "Replace Clip". Universal Paste instantly swaps the media while preserving the original clip duration, timeline position, scale, and applied keyframe effects.
- **Q: Does Universal Paste save files to the desktop?**
  A: No. Universal Paste saves all ingested assets directly into organized, date-stamped project media folders, keeping your desktop clean and ensuring project files remain properly linked.
- **Q: Does Universal Paste work offline without external servers?**
  A: Yes, 100%. All clipboard processing, screenshot snipping, screen recordings, and Premiere Pro timeline insertions execute completely offline on your local machine. Your assets, footage, and project files never leave your system.
- **Q: What media formats are supported by Universal Paste?**
  A: Universal Paste supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, WebP, animated GIFs, MP4, WebM, clipboard bitmap buffers, and direct video/media URLs.
- **Q: Which versions of Adobe Premiere Pro are compatible?**
  A: Compatible with Adobe Premiere Pro 24.0 (2024), 25.0+ (2025), and later releases on Windows 10/11 64-bit (macOS support in development).
